column1: # Cases for 015_api_key_expiry_canonical, one per line, tab-separated:
#   stored expires_at <TAB> expires_at after the repair <TAB> active|revoked
# `active` is exactly the rows `repo::parse_iso` reads; the SQLite test
# asserts that against the parser before it asserts anything about the SQL.
# CI's PostgreSQL job loads this file with `\copy`, so no value may contain a
# tab or a backslash, begin with `#`, or carry a NUL (PostgreSQL `text` cannot
# hold one; the NUL case is its own SQLite test).
